source: Creely et al., J. Plasma Phys. 86 (2020)
notes: Full-field H-mode case. Printed in Creely et al. 2020: R, a, B, Ip, kappa_sep, delta_sep, P_aux_max (maximum coupled auxiliary power), P_fusion, Q (Table 1, p. 6); n_e, P_aux (the case's RF power P_RF), tau_E, beta_N, H98y2 (Table 2, p. 13); kappa = kappa_a = kappa_95 = 1.75, delta_95 = 0.45, q95 = 3.4 (p. 14). P_loss is not printed: 29.0 MW is derived from Table 2, P_sep B0/R0 = 191 MW T/m, times R0/B0. IPB98(y,2) with these inputs gives 0.765 s against the printed 0.77 s. P_loss is used for IPB98(y,2) confinement regression checks.
